_comment: JOURNEYS — step-by-step flows walked on both environments — are NOT used for
Ekshamata. The comparison is the four signed-in pages in compare-routes.json
(Homepage · My Courses · Account · Competency), run as one org's paired
accounts. The signup wizard in particular is deliberately not walked: it sends
real OTPs and creates real accounts, and it is not what a release breaks.
The machinery still exists (scripts/lib/journey.mjs). To use it, add entries
below and pass --journey <id>. Nothing runs unless a journey is named.
